keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «나무꾼이 금도끼를 자기 것이 아니라고 정직하게 대답한 일(사건)» 과 «정직함이 언제나 가장 좋은 선택이라는 교훈(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the event (the woodcutter honestly said the golden axe was not his) and the lesson (honesty is always the best choice). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why did the woodcutter sit down and cry?
opts: It was the only axe he had.
He cut his hand on the tree.
The spirit was angry with him.
evs: Suddenly, his old iron axe slipped and fell into the water.
He sat down and cried because it was the only axe he had.
A mountain spirit came out of the river holding a golden axe.
At last, the spirit brought out the old iron axe, and the woodcutter smiled.
why: 그것이 나무꾼이 가진 하나뿐인 도끼였기 때문이라고 나와 있어요.
The text says he cried because it was the only axe he had.

qs.q: In "At last, the spirit brought out the old iron axe," what does "At last" mean?
qs.qko: «마침내 산신령이 낡은 쇠도끼를 꺼냈다» 에서 «마침내» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: The spirit showed him a silver axe, but he said no again.
A poor woodcutter was cutting a tree beside a deep river.
"Yes, that one is mine!" he said.
He sat down and cried because it was the only axe he had.
why: 산신령은 금도끼, 은도끼를 먼저 보여 준 뒤에 쇠도끼를 꺼냈어요. 여러 번 해 본 끝에 드디어라는 뜻이에요.
The spirit showed the golden and silver axes first. So «At last» means finally, after other tries.

qs.q: Why did the spirit give the woodcutter all three axes?
qs.qko: 산신령은 왜 나무꾼에게 도끼 세 개를 모두 주었나요?
opts: He told the truth about his axe.
He asked for the golden axe.
evs: "No, it is not," the woodcutter answered honestly.
The spirit was so pleased with his honesty that he gave him all three axes.
He sat down and cried because it was the only axe he had.
A mountain spirit came out of the river holding a golden axe.
why: 나무꾼은 금도끼가 자기 것이 아니라고 정직하게 대답했고, 산신령은 그 정직함이 마음에 들어서 도끼를 모두 주었어요.
The woodcutter answered honestly, and the spirit was pleased with his honesty, so he gave him all three axes.

ends: A greedy neighbor tries to trick the spirit.
욕심 많은 이웃이 산신령을 속이려 해요.
The woodcutter shares his new axes with the village.
나무꾼이 새 도끼를 마을 사람들과 나눠요.

write.src: “It is important to <u>tell the truth</u> because <u>people can trust you</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «중요한 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what is important and your reason in English.

chips.b: the owner is looking for them
chips.label: lost things

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because people can trust you)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because people can trust you)

img.cover: By a deep blue river in the mountains, an old man with a long white beard and flowing white robes rises from the water holding a golden axe and a silver axe, while a thin woodcutter with a short black beard, old patched gray clothes and a straw hat kneels on the riverbank.

scenes.1: The old man with a long white beard and flowing white robes stands above the river water holding out a shiny golden axe, and the thin woodcutter with a short black beard, patched gray clothes and a straw hat shakes his head.
scenes.2: On the riverbank, the thin woodcutter with a short black beard, patched gray clothes and a straw hat smiles while holding an old iron axe, as the old man with a long white beard and white robes hands him a golden axe and a silver axe too.
